entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while back. I need to return a jersey I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I got it about a month and a half ago, maybe 50 days? I tried it on, and it's just the wrong size. It's much too tight in the shoulders.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up. VF-8675309... I see it here. Yes, it was delivered 50 days ago. Since that's within our 90-day return window, I can absolutely process this return for you. No problem at all.

That's great to hear. I was hoping to do an exchange for the next size up. Since I have to go through the trouble of packaging it and sending it back, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my trouble?

I understand. We can definitely process this as an exchange to get you the right size. I've just checked, and unfortunately, I'm not able to offer a discount code for a standard size-related return. However, the return shipping is completely free for you.
I see. So no small credit to my account or anything like that? Even a 10% off coupon for a future order would be appreciated. I'm a loyal customer.

I do appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit, and I'm sorry, but my system doesn't allow for goodwill credits on sizing exchanges. I can confirm the process is very simple, and we'll ship the new jersey out as soon as we see the return tracking activate. I've just sent the prepaid return label to your email.
Okay, free shipping is fair. I had to try. Thanks for processing the return for the jersey. I'll get it sent back this week.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Have a good rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
